Battleship is a naval strategy game for Android. You place your fleet, then you and the enemy take turns firing at each other\'s ships. The app plays the enemy, so you play alone and offline. Sink all five enemy ships to win, and earn ranks, medals and badges along the way.
Battleship does not collect, send or share any personal data.
The app has no permission to use the internet, so it cannot send your data anywhere. It contains no ads, analytics or crash reports.
Your game record (statistics, ranks, medals and badges) stays on your phone. We never receive it.
See the source code on GitHub
Reporting a problem needs a free GitHub account.
